query: With dynamic VRAM, 2-pass Qwen-Image-Edit unloads all models between samplers and after the run (RAM flushed), doubling generation time vs --disable-dynamic-vram.

desired.outcome: Workaround --disable-dynamic-vram confirmed working by Kozatiju (C5) and others, but rattus128 only reproduced/asked for logs and the flag is slated for removal; underlying reload behavior not fixed.
